paper.title_en: On the Role of Gravity in Supercooled Phase Transitions
paper.abstract_en: Theories with radiative mass generation and radiative symmetry breaking (RSB) lead to first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) and the production of gravitational waves (GWs) as well as primordial black holes if supercooling lasts long enough. Here we investigate the role of gravity in supercooled FOPTs that occur in the RSB scenario. We use a model-independent approach that is valid when a quantity (which we explicitly determine and is computable once the model is specified) is small enough. Eventually, the curvature of spacetime becomes relevant if the FOPT does not complete in the case in which gravity is ignored. We also include the effect on the FOPT of the non-minimal couplings with coefficients of zero mass dimension. Depending on such non-minimal couplings, gravity can enhance or reduce the region of parameter space where the phase transition completes. Observable consequences of the role of gravity on the FOPT that can be probed by current and future GW detectors are then worked out and we explore the possibility that the background of GWs detected by pulsar timing arrays is produced by FOPTs in the RSB scenario. We also estimate the number of e-folds that elapse when the field playing the role of the order parameter is trapped in the false vacuum, which provides important information for cosmology.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究辐射对称性破缺场景中超冷一阶相变中引力的作用，包含非最小耦合、时空曲率效应，并明确讨论脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景是否可能由该类相变产生，与该索引的PTA主题直接相关；同时涉及广义相对论基础与相变相关的引力效应。摘要给出了模型无关方法及其适用条件，理论深度较高，选题新，写作清晰。论文仅4天，零引用不作负面评价。
decision.title_zh: 论引力在过冷相变中的作用
decision.abstract_zh: 具有辐射质量产生和辐射对称性破缺（RSB）的理论会导致一阶相变（FOPT），并且如果过冷持续时间足够长，还会产生引力波（GWs）以及原初黑洞。本文研究在RSB场景中发生的过冷FOPT中引力的作用。我们采用一种模型无关的方法，只要某个量（我们明确给出该量，并且一旦模型确定它便可计算）足够小，该方法就有效。最终，如果在忽略引力时FOPT无法完成，那么时空曲率就会变得重要。我们还纳入了质量量纲为零的系数所对应的非最小耦合对FOPT的影响。取决于这些非最小耦合，引力可以扩大或缩小相变得以完成的参数空间区域。随后，我们给出了引力对FOPT作用的可观测后果，这些后果可由当前和未来的GW探测器探测，并且我们探索了脉冲星计时阵列探测到的GW背景由RSB场景中的FOPT产生的可能性。我们还估计了当充当序参量的场被困在假真空中时所经过的e-folds数目，这为宇宙学提供了重要信息。
